description: Na₅Bi₂As₅O₁₈ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six AsO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent BiO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.67 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.92 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one BiO₆ octahedra, corners with six AsO₄ tetrahedra,  a faceface with one BiO₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one NaO₅ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 74°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.71 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.88 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share corners with five AsO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one BiO₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.54 Å. There are two inequivalent Bi sites. In the first Bi site, Bi is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted BiO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with six AsO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid, and  a faceface with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 74°. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.55 Å. In the second Bi site, Bi is bonded to six O atoms to form BiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six AsO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.47 Å. There are five inequivalent As sites. In the first As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two BiO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid, and  a cornercorner with one AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-53°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.68-1.83 Å. In the second As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent BiO₆ octahedra, corners with three NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid, and  a cornercorner with one AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-68°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.69-1.79 Å. In the third As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with three BiO₆ octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-66°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.70-1.79 Å. In the fourth As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four BiO₆ octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-66°. There are three shorter (1.72 Å) and one longer (1.74 Å) As-O bond length. In the fifth As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one BiO₆ octahedra, corners with three NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, and  a cornercorner with one AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-60°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.69-1.81 Å. There are eighteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Bi, and one As atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one As atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na and one As atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃As trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Bi, and one As atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two As atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Bi and one As atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Bi, and one As atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Bi, and one As atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one As atom to form distorted ONa₃As trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂BiAs tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃As trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂BiAs trigonal pyramid. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Bi, and one As atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one As atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Bi, and one As atom to form distorted ONa₂BiAs tetrahedra that share corners with three ONa₃As trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂BiAs tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂BiAs trigonal pyramid. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Bi, and one As atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Bi, and one As atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Bi, and one As atom. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Bi, and one As atom. In the seventeenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two As atoms. In the eighteenth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Bi, and one As atom to form distorted ONa₂BiAs trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₂BiAs tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃As trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂BiAs tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃As trigonal pyramid.
